questions.question: By definition, which of these is "roadworthy"?

options.text: Any vehicle less than 5 years old
A vehicle that complies with the Act and is otherwise fit to be operated on a public road
Any vehicle with a valid licence disc
A vehicle that has been washed and serviced

questions.explanation: "Roadworthy" means a vehicle which complies with the relevant provisions of the Act and is otherwise in a fit condition to be operated on a public road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.8)

questions.question: What is a "trailer"?

options.text: A vehicle that is not self-propelled and is designed to be drawn by a motor vehicle (not including a motorcycle sidecar)
Any vehicle being towed with a rope

questions.explanation: "Trailer" means a vehicle which is not self-propelled and designed to be drawn by a motor vehicle, but does not include a sidecar.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.9)

questions.question: What is the maximum overall height of a double-deck bus?
questions.explanation: Overall height may not exceed 4,65 m for a double-deck bus and 4,3 m for any other motor vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.31 (p.25)

questions.question: This sign means: "Soft shoulder".
questions.explanation: Soft shoulder (TW342): do not drive or stop on the shoulder.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 TW342 (p.31)

questions.question: Where must the licence disc be displayed on a motor car?

options.text: On the lower right-hand corner on the outside of the windscreen
On the lower left-hand corner on the inside of the windscreen

questions.explanation: Cut out the disc and affix it to the lower left-hand corner on the inside of the windscreen or disc holder (Regulation 36).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.9); National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000, Reg 36

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Do not pass to the left of the sign
Do not pass to the right of the sign

questions.explanation: Delineator plates (W402): do not pass to the left of W402.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W402 (p.33)

questions.question: A main beam (bright lights) must be able to show a person or vehicle at a distance of at least ____ ahead.
questions.explanation: The main beam must illuminate persons/vehicles at least 100 m ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.2 (p.16)

questions.question: What is the maximum overall length of a combination of vehicles (other than a bus-train)?
questions.explanation: A combination of vehicles may not exceed 22 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.30 (p.24)

questions.question: A ____ line painted along the edge of the road means no stopping.
questions.explanation: No stopping lines (RM12) are red; no parking lines (RM13) are yellow.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM12 (p.51)

questions.question: You may not stop alongside or opposite another vehicle where the roadway is less than ____ wide.
questions.explanation: No stopping alongside or opposite another vehicle where the roadway is less than 9 m wide.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.48 (p.31)

questions.question: This sign means: "Traffic signals ahead".
questions.explanation: False. Emergency flashing light (W346): a hazard ahead; look out for other signs. ("Traffic signals ahead" is the meaning of W301.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W346 (p.31)

questions.question: Where this sign is displayed, when may you stop?

options.text: For up to 5 minutes to drop off passengers
Only to load or off-load goods
Only to obey a traffic light or traffic officer, or to avoid a collision
At any time if you leave the hazard lights on

questions.explanation: Stopping prohibited (R217): do not stop unless to obey a traffic light or officer or to avoid a collision.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R217 (p.12)

questions.question: Which control is used to keep the vehicle stationary after parking?
questions.explanation: The hand brake (7).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Road narrows from both sides".
questions.explanation: Road narrows from both sides (W328).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W328 (p.29)

questions.question: Put the starting procedure for a manual-transmission car in the correct order.

options.text: Turn the ignition key further to start the engine
Turn the ignition key to "on" without starting the engine
Check warning lights and gauges for malfunction
Release hold on the key as soon as the engine starts
Ensure that the parking brake is applied
Ensure that the gear lever is in neutral

questions.explanation: LMV Module 3 starting procedure (manual transmission).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 3 (p.19)

questions.question: Tap the left and right rear-view mirrors in this automatic-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The left and right rear-view mirrors is control 3.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Combined curves: first sharp curve to the right
Two-way traffic crossroad ahead (one-way street crossed by a two-way street)

questions.explanation: Hairpin bend (W206/W207): a very sharp U-shaped curve ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W206 (p.25)

questions.question: A flashing green arrow is shown together with a steady red light. What does it mean?

options.text: You may proceed in the direction of the arrow, giving way to pedestrians and vehicles lawfully in the intersection
The lights are out of order

questions.explanation: A flashing green arrow with a steady red indicates traffic may proceed in the direction of the arrow subject to the right of way of pedestrians and vehicles lawfully within the intersection.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 41 (p.62)

questions.question: Match each control to what it is used for.

options.text: To advise other road users of your intention to turn or change direction
To keep the vehicle stationary after parking
To increase the speed of the vehicle

questions.explanation: Accelerator: to increase the speed of the vehicle. Brake: to decrease speed or stop. Hand brake (parking brake): to keep the vehicle stationary after parking. Indicator light switch: to advise other road users of your intention to turn or change direction.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Match the numbered controls of this automatic car to their names.
questions.explanation: 1 = centre mirror, 3 = side mirrors, 5 = indicator switch, 11 = horn.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: Which sign means: "One-way roadway to the right"?
questions.explanation: One-way roadway (R4.1/4.2/4.3): a one-way carriageway lies in the direction of the arrow.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R4.2 (p.5)

questions.question: What is the minimum following distance a motorcyclist should keep in normal conditions?
questions.explanation: MC Module 22: obtain and where possible maintain a minimum 2-second following distance, increased in adverse conditions.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Motor Cycles manual Part 1, Module 22 (p.39)

questions.question: What does this yellow overhead arrow mean?

options.text: Your lane is closed ahead – leave it in the direction of the arrow

questions.explanation: Yellow arrow (S18/S19): the lane you are driving in is closed ahead; leave the lane in the direction of the arrow.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §8 S18 (p.56)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Lane ends: the left-hand lane ends
Winding road (first bend to the left)

questions.explanation: Sharp curve (W204/W205): slow down to take the curve safely.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W205 (p.25)

questions.question: Which colour warning light is used by vehicles of traffic officers on duty?
questions.explanation: Vehicles driven by traffic officers in carrying out their duties use blue warning lights.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.16 (p.20)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yield to pedestrians (R2.1): give priority to pedestrians crossing or wanting to cross and be ready to stop.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R2.1 (p.5)

questions.question: The signal changes to this as you approach. What must you do?

options.text: Stop only if pedestrians are crossing
Proceed – amber means go with caution
Stop, unless you cannot stop safely

questions.explanation: Amber: stop, except where it cannot be done safely.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §8 Traffic signals (p.56)

questions.question: You may leave an animal in a place from which it may stray onto a freeway.
questions.explanation: No person shall leave or allow an animal on a freeway or leave it where it may stray onto a freeway.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.56 (p.35)

questions.question: You are at this sign. Which movements are allowed?

options.text: Turn left or make a U-turn

questions.explanation: Left turn prohibited (R211): you may proceed straight or turn right.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R211 (p.12)

questions.question: You are driving a truck. What does this sign prohibit?
questions.explanation: R215: if you are driving a heavy motor vehicle, do not overtake another heavy vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R215 (p.12)

questions.question: A junction includes any stop or yield line marking painted at the intersection.
questions.explanation: "Junction" includes any portion of the roadway between the lateral limits and any stop or yield line marking painted at the intersection.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.5)

questions.question: Tap the horn in this manual-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The horn is control 11.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: Tap the steering wheel in this manual-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The steering wheel is control 4.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: What is the brake used for?

options.text: To advise other road users of your intention to turn or change direction
To see what is to the rear of the vehicle
To change the direction of the vehicle (steer left or right)

questions.explanation: The brake is used to decrease speed or stop.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Minibuses only (R119): the road or part of the road is set aside for minibuses.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R119 (p.7)

questions.question: Which of these are driving signals? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Driving signals are direction indicators, horn, brake lights, headlamps and hand signals.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Signal – driving (p.84)

questions.question: The driver of this car is giving a hand signal. What does it mean?

options.text: Stopping or sudden reduction of speed

questions.explanation: Turning left (car): extend the right arm sideways from the shoulder, forearm vertical and downward from the elbow, and move it in a circular anti-clockwise motion.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 7 (p.23)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Winding road (first bend to the right)
Two-way traffic crossroad ahead (one-way street crossed by a two-way street)

questions.explanation: Two-way traffic crossroad (W213): your one-way street will be crossed by a street carrying two-way traffic.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W213 (p.26)

questions.question: Before opening your door after parking, what must you do?

options.text: Check rear-view mirrors and blind spots

questions.explanation: Check rear-view mirrors and blind spots before opening doors.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 31 (p.52)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Motorcycles only (R116): only motorcyclists may use this road or part of the road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R116 (p.7)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Pedal cyclists ahead (next 2 km)".
questions.explanation: Pedal cyclists (W309): look out for cyclists for the next 2 km.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W309 (p.27)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving heavy vehicles (W324): heavy vehicles travel slowly down a descent.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W324 (p.29)

questions.question: The driver of this car is giving a hand signal. What does it mean?

options.text: Stopping or sudden reduction of speed

questions.explanation: Turning right: extend the right arm horizontally from the shoulder with the palm of the hand to the front.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 8 (p.24)

questions.question: In this automatic-transmission car, what is control number 9?
questions.explanation: Control 9 is the brake.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: Which sign tells you to drive no slower than the speed shown?
questions.explanation: Minimum speed (R101) is a blue command disc; R201 (red ring) is a maximum speed limit.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R101 (p.6)

questions.question: Tractors may use a freeway only when…

options.text: Used in connection with the construction or maintenance of the freeway

questions.explanation: A tractor may not be used on a freeway except in connection with its construction or maintenance.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.56 (p.35)

questions.question: A warning triangle must be placed at least ____ from the stationary vehicle.
questions.explanation: The warning sign (triangle) must be placed not less than 45 m from the vehicle, towards approaching traffic.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.24 (p.23)

questions.question: When may you stop on a roadway where stopping is otherwise not allowed? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: For a cause beyond your control
When directed by a traffic officer

questions.explanation: Stopping exceptions: to avoid an accident, on a traffic officer's direction, or for any cause beyond the driver's control.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.48 (p.31)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?
questions.explanation: Falling rocks (W334): rocks could fall from the left.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W334 (p.30)

questions.question: What is a "traffic signal"?

options.text: A flashing amber light on a vehicle
A hand signal given by a driver
A road traffic sign that, by means of automatic light signals, alternately directs traffic to stop and to proceed

questions.explanation: "Traffic signal" means a road traffic sign which by means of automatic light signals alternately directs traffic to stop and permits it to proceed.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.9)

questions.question: An automatic car does not have a ____ pedal.
questions.explanation: Automatic vehicles do not have a clutch control.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: Match each alcohol limit to the correct driver and test.
questions.explanation: Blood: 0,05 g/100 ml (0,02 professional). Breath: 0,24 mg/1 000 ml (0,10 professional).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.65 (p.38); National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996, s65

questions.question: What is the maximum number of persons who may ride on a motorcycle (excluding a sidecar)?
questions.explanation: Not more than two persons shall ride upon a motorcycle, excluding a person in a sidecar.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.50 (p.33)

questions.question: Tap the window wiper in this automatic-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The window wiper is control 2.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: Which of these is a "STOP ahead" warning sign?
questions.explanation: W302 (traffic control "STOP" ahead) is a triangular warning sign containing a small stop sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W302 (p.26)

questions.question: When passing an on-ramp on a freeway, what should you do?

options.text: Adjust your speed and position to help vehicles join the freeway, if necessary
Speed up to stop them merging

questions.explanation: On approach to an on-ramp, check mirrors and blind spot and adjust speed and position to facilitate the entry of vehicles about to join the freeway.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 55 (p.76)

questions.question: If a pedestrian figure signal starts flashing red, pedestrians already in the intersection must cross as quickly as possible.
questions.explanation: If the red figure signal flashes, pedestrians who have not entered must wait; those already in the intersection must cross as quickly as possible.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §8 Traffic signals (p.56)

questions.question: Goods carried on a motorcycle may not project more than how far in front of the front axle?
questions.explanation: Goods on a motorcycle may not project more than 600 mm in front of the front axle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.35 (p.26)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Gravel road ends"?
questions.explanation: Gravel road ends (W363): look out for a tar or concrete road ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W363 (p.33)

questions.question: After a motor vehicle licence expires, there is a grace period of ____ during which the vehicle may still be used.
questions.explanation: A vehicle may be operated within 21 days after the date of expiry.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.8 (p.15)

questions.question: This sign means: "The sign above applies at night only".
questions.explanation: Night time (R512): the regulatory sign applies only at night.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.6 R512 (p.20)

questions.question: You are towing a trailer. What does this sign mean for you?

options.text: Do not enter – vehicles towing another vehicle are prohibited
Towing is only allowed with a tow-bar

questions.explanation: Towed vehicles prohibited (R240): do not enter the area if you are towing another vehicle or trailer.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R240 (p.15)

questions.question: What should you do at this sign if you do not know how deep the water is?

options.text: Switch on the hazard lights and continue

questions.explanation: Drift (W350): slow down and, if it is not known how deep the water is, stop. If passable, drive through slowly.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W350 (p.32)

questions.question: When moving off in a manual car, selecting a gear, obtaining clutch control and observing may be done in one flowing movement.
questions.explanation: Numbers 7, 8 and 9 (select gear, clutch control, observe) may be done in one flowing movement.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 12 (p.28)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Taxis prohibited"?
questions.explanation: Taxis prohibited (R224).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R224 (p.13)

questions.question: Which emergency vehicles use a red warning light? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Fire-fighting, fire-fighting response, rescue, emergency medical response vehicles and ambulances use red lights; traffic officers blue; civil protection green.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.16 (p.20)

questions.question: What is the general speed limit on a public road within an urban area?
questions.explanation: General speed limits: 60 km/h in urban areas, 100 km/h outside urban areas, 120 km/h on freeways.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.27 (p.24); National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000, Reg 292

questions.question: What is the maximum speed for a bus or minibus?
questions.explanation: Buses and minibuses are limited to 100 km/h.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.28 (p.24)

questions.question: Which control is each number? Match them.
questions.explanation: 1 = Centre rear-view mirror. 2 = Window wiper. 5 = Indicator light switch. 6 = Gear lever.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: You may refuse to give a blood or breath specimen when requested.
questions.explanation: No person shall refuse that a specimen of blood or breath be taken of him or her.
questions.manualRef: National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996, s65(9)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Sharp curve to the left (chevron)".
questions.explanation: Sharp curve chevron (W406/W408): the road curves suddenly to the left.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W406 (p.34)

questions.question: This sign means: "Cyclists and pedestrians only".
questions.explanation: False. R126: the road or part of the road is set aside for vehicles conveying dangerous goods. ("Cyclists and pedestrians only" is the meaning of R112.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R126 (p.8)

questions.question: Which control do you use to keep the windscreen clear in rainy conditions?
questions.explanation: The window wiper (2) keeps the windscreen clear in the rain.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: When may you cross this solid line to your right?

options.text: Whenever the road ahead is clear for 500 m
To get direct access to an entrance on the other side, or to pass a stationary obstruction, if safe

questions.explanation: No overtaking line (RM1): do not cross except to gain direct access to an entrance, from such an entrance to the road, or to pass a stationary obstruction, when safe.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM1 (p.48)

questions.question: What is the correct driving position?

options.text: Knee slightly bent when the clutch is fully depressed, and arms slightly bent with hands at twelve o'clock on the wheel
As far back as the seat goes
As close to the wheel as possible

questions.explanation: The distance from the wheel should allow the knee to be slightly bent with the clutch fully depressed, and the arms slightly bent with hands at the twelve o'clock position.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Driving position (p.80)

questions.question: By definition, a "motor vehicle" includes a trailer.
questions.explanation: "Motor vehicle" means any self-propelled vehicle and includes a trailer.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.6)

questions.question: What must you do immediately if you are involved in an accident?

options.text: Move the vehicles off the road
Drive to the nearest police station

questions.explanation: Any driver involved in an accident must immediately stop the vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.62 (p.37)

questions.question: Tap the left and right rear-view mirrors in this manual-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The left and right rear-view mirrors is control 3.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: Someone was injured in an accident and the vehicles completely obstruct the road. When may a vehicle be moved?

options.text: Only once its position has been clearly marked on the road surface, or a traffic officer authorises it
Only after the tow truck arrives
Never until the police have taken photographs

questions.explanation: A vehicle may not be moved unless its position has been clearly marked on the road surface or a traffic officer authorised the removal.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.62 (p.37)

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road you are on?

options.text: The one-way roadway will soon become two-way
The road is closed in both directions

questions.explanation: Two-way traffic (W212): the one-way roadway you are travelling on will soon become a two-way roadway.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W212 (p.26)

questions.question: Which hand signal does a motorcyclist give to show an intention to turn left?

options.text: Right arm extended with forearm vertically upward
Right arm with forearm moving in an anti-clockwise circle
Left arm extended horizontally sideways from the shoulder, palm facing forward

questions.explanation: MC Module 7: extend the left arm horizontally sideways from the shoulder, with palm facing forward.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Motor Cycles manual Part 1, Module 7 (p.24)

questions.question: In this automatic car, which control do you check before slowing down?
questions.explanation: Control 1 is the centre rear-view mirror.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Match each regulatory sign shown to what it means.

options.text: Towed vehicles prohibited (no towing beyond this sign)
Motorcycles prohibited (on a freeway, leave at the first exit)

questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R218: Pedestrians prohibited. Sign 2 is R222: Motorcycles prohibited (on a freeway, leave at the first exit). Sign 3 is R240: Towed vehicles prohibited (no towing beyond this sign). Sign 4 is R216: No parking.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R218 (p.13), R222 (p.13), R240 (p.15), R216 (p.12)

questions.question: A motorcyclist may hold on to another moving vehicle to be pulled along.
questions.explanation: A rider or passenger shall not take hold of any other vehicle in motion.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.50 (p.33)

questions.question: When may you cross a public road?

options.text: Whenever you have the right of way
When the traffic is moving slowly
Only when it is clear of moving traffic for a sufficient distance to cross without obstructing or endangering traffic

questions.explanation: Do not cross a road unless it is clear of moving traffic for a sufficient distance to cross safely.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.59 (p.36)

questions.question: This sign means: "Pedal cycles and pedestrians prohibited".
questions.explanation: R220: cyclists and pedestrians may not proceed beyond this sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R220 (p.13)

questions.question: A person may apply for a learner's licence for a class of vehicle he or she is already licensed to drive.
questions.explanation: A person is disqualified if the licence relates to a class of vehicle he or she may already drive under a licence held.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – §4.1 Disqualification (p.11)

questions.question: When may you drive your vehicle backwards (reverse) on a public road?

options.text: Only when it can be done in safety

questions.explanation: You may not cause a vehicle to travel backwards unless it can be done in safety.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.49 (p.32)

questions.question: A child aged 10 who is taller than 1,5 m is regarded as an adult for seatbelt purposes.
questions.explanation: A child taller than 1,5 m is regarded as an adult, irrespective of age.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.17 (p.20)

questions.question: A learner's licence is valid for 12 months.
questions.explanation: A learner's licence is valid for 24 months from the date of the test.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.1 (p.12)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends: the right-hand lane ends
Combined curves: first sharp curve to the right

questions.explanation: Combined curves (W210): two sharp curves in opposite directions, the first to the right.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W210 (p.25)

questions.question: In which direction is the first bend on the road indicated by this sign?
questions.explanation: Winding road: in the case of W208 the first bend is to the right (W209: first bend left).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W208 (p.22)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Multi-phase traffic signals: your signal may stay red while oncoming traffic gets green
You have right of way at the intersection ahead

questions.explanation: Cul-de-sac (IN4–IN6): the road ahead (or to the left/right) ends.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §6 IN4 (p.46)

questions.question: What is "riding the clutch"?

options.text: Resting your foot on the clutch pedal while moving, or keeping it depressed while stationary for any length of time

questions.explanation: Riding the clutch is resting the foot on the clutch pedal whilst the vehicle is in motion or keeping the clutch depressed whilst stationary; it causes excessive wear.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Clutch – rides (p.80)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Combined curves: first sharp curve to the left".
questions.explanation: Combined curves (W211): two sharp curves in opposite directions, the first to the left.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W211 (p.25)

questions.question: What does "acceptable identification" include for a person not permanently resident in South Africa?

options.text: An identity document issued by a foreign country, or a traffic register number certificate

questions.explanation: For a person not permanently resident: an identity document issued by a foreign country or a traffic register number certificate.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.2)

questions.question: In this automatic-transmission car, what is control number 10?
questions.explanation: Control 10 is the accelerator.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: Put the steps for giving a left-turn hand signal from a car in the correct order.

options.text: Turn forearm vertically downward and move it in an anti-clockwise circle
Check blind spot to the right
Extend right arm sideways from shoulder
Check rear-view mirror(s) and blind spot to the left
Retract arm in good time and replace hand on steering wheel

questions.explanation: LMV Module 7 sets out these steps for the left-turn hand signal.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 7 (p.23)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Pedestrian priority area (max 15 km/h for permitted vehicles)

questions.explanation: No entry (R3): no traffic may proceed past the sign; do not enter the carriageway. Usually at the end of a one-way street or off-ramp.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R3 (p.5)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Pedestrian priority area (max 15 km/h for permitted vehicles)
Stop – but you may turn left without stopping if you yield to traffic

questions.explanation: Yield sign (R2): you must yield to other traffic; reduce speed and stop if necessary.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R2 (p.4)
